# AI News Hub Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build a static AI news aggregation site with Astro, auto-built twice daily via GitHub Actions and deployed to Cloudflare Pages.

**Architecture:** Static site generated by Astro. A Node.js script fetches RSS feeds + GitHub Trending on schedule (GitHub Actions), writing structured JSON into `src/data/news.json`. Astro reads this during build to generate pages. Pagefind indexes content for offline search. Deployment to Cloudflare Pages.

**Tech Stack:** Astro 5, Tailwind CSS 4, TypeScript, Pagefind, rss-parser, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare Pages

**Design Doc:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-23-ai-news-hub-design.md`

### Task 2: RSS Fetch Script

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/fetch-news.mjs`

- [ ] **Step 1: Create the RSS fetch script**

Create `/Users/tian_d/ai-news-hub/scripts/fetch-news.mjs`:

```javascript
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import Parser from 'rss-parser';

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

const parser = new Parser({
  timeout: 15000,
  headers: { 'User-Agent': 'AI-News-Hub/1.0' },
});

// Source definitions: name, feed URL, category, optional image field mapping
const SOURCES = [
  { name: 'TechCrunch', url: 'https://techcrunch.com/category/artificial-intelligence/feed/', category: 'industry' },
  { name: 'The Verge', url: 'https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/rss.xml', category: 'industry' },
  { name: 'Ars Technica', url: 'https://feeds.arstechnica.com/arstechnica/index', category: 'research' },
  { name: 'Hugging Face', url: 'https://huggingface.co/blog/feed.xml', category: 'opensource' },
  { name: 'Google AI', url: 'https://blog.research.google/atom.xml', category: 'research' },
  { name: 'Meta AI', url: 'https://ai.meta.com/blog/feed.xml', category: 'research' },
  { name: 'MIT Tech Review', url: 'https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/artificial-intelligence/feed/', category: 'research' },
  { name: 'OpenAI', url: 'https://openai.com/blog/rss.xml', category: 'industry' },
];

function slugify(text) {
  return text
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, '')
    .slice(0, 50);
}

function extractImage(item) {
  // Try standard feed image, media:content, or enclosure
  if (item.enclosure?.url) return item.enclosure.url;
  const mediaContent = item['media:content']?.$.url;
  if (mediaContent) return mediaContent;
  // Try to extract first image from content
  const content = item['content:encoded'] || item.content || '';
  const match = content.match(/<img[^>]+src=["']([^"']+)["']/);
  return match ? match[1] : undefined;
}

async function fetchSource(source) {
  try {
    const feed = await parser.parseURL(source.url);
    const items = (feed.items || []).slice(0, 15).map((item) => {
      const id = slugify(item.title || '') + '-' + Date.now();
      return {
        id,
        title: item.title || 'Untitled',
        url: item.link || '',
        summary: (item.contentSnippet || item.content || '').slice(0, 500),
        source: source.name,
        category: source.category,
        publishedAt: item.isoDate || item.pubDate || new Date().toISOString(),
        imageUrl: extractImage(item),
        type: 'article',
      };
    });
    console.log(`  ✓ ${source.name}: ${items.length} items`);
    return items;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`  ✗ ${source.name}: ${err.message}`);
    return [];
  }
}

async function main() {
  console.log('Fetching RSS feeds...');
  const allItems = [];

  for (const source of SOURCES) {
    const items = await fetchSource(source);
    allItems.push(...items);
  }

  // Deduplicate by URL
  const seen = new Set();
  const deduped = allItems.filter((item) => {
    if (seen.has(item.url)) return false;
    seen.add(item.url);
    return true;
  });

  // Sort by publishedAt descending
  deduped.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.publishedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.publishedAt).getTime());

  // Limit to latest 100 items
  const final = deduped.slice(0, 100);

  const dataPath = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'src', 'data', 'news.json');
  const existing = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(dataPath, 'utf-8'));
  const merged = mergeNews(existing, final).slice(0, 200);

  fs.writeFileSync(dataPath, JSON.stringify(merged, null, 2), 'utf-8');
  console.log(`\nDone: ${final.length} new items, ${merged.length} total in database`);
}

function mergeNews(existing, incoming) {
  const map = new Map();
  for (const item of existing) map.set(item.url, item);
  for (const item of incoming) map.set(item.url, item);
  return [...map.values()].sort(
    (a, b) => new Date(b.publishedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.publishedAt).getTime()
  );
}

main().catch(console.error);
```

Expected: Script runs without error, `src/data/news.json` contains fetched articles.

### Task 3: GitHub Trending Fetch Script

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/fetch-trending.mjs`

- [ ] **Step 1: Create the GitHub trending script**

Create `/Users/tian_d/ai-news-hub/scripts/fetch-trending.mjs`:

```javascript
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

const TRENDING_URL = 'https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=topic:ai+topic:machine-learning+topic:deep-learning&sort=stars&order=desc&per_page=30';

async function main() {
  console.log('Fetching GitHub trending AI repos...');

  const res = await fetch(TRENDING_URL, {
    headers: { 'User-Agent': 'AI-News-Hub/1.0', Accept: 'application/vnd.github.v3+json' },
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    console.error(`  ✗ GitHub API: ${res.status} ${res.statusText}`);
    return;
  }

  const data = await res.json();
  const repos = (data.items || []).slice(0, 20).map((repo) => ({
    id: `gh-${repo.id}`,
    title: `${repo.full_name}: ${repo.description || ''}`.slice(0, 200),
    url: repo.html_url,
    summary: repo.description || repo.full_name,
    source: 'GitHub',
    category: 'trending',
    publishedAt: repo.created_at,
    imageUrl: repo.owner?.avatar_url,
    type: 'repo',
    stars: repo.stargazers_count,
    language: repo.language || 'Unknown',
  }));

  console.log(`  ✓ GitHub Trending: ${repos.length} repos`);

  const dataPath = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'src', 'data', 'news.json');
  const existing = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(dataPath, 'utf-8'));
  const map = new Map();
  for (const item of existing) map.set(item.url, item);
  for (const repo of repos) map.set(repo.url, repo);

  const merged = [...map.values()].sort(
    (a, b) => new Date(b.publishedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.publishedAt).getTime()
  ).slice(0, 200);

  fs.writeFileSync(dataPath, JSON.stringify(merged, null, 2), 'utf-8');
  console.log(`\nDone: merged ${repos.length} repos, ${merged.length} total items`);
}

main().catch(console.error);
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Run the script to verify**

Run: `cd /Users/tian_d/ai-news-hub && node scripts/fetch-trending.mjs`
Expected: Script runs without error, `src/data/news.json` now includes trending repos alongside articles.

```astro
const catEmoji = CATEGORY_EMOJIS[item.category] || '📄';

function timeAgo(dateStr: string): string {
  const now = Date.now();
  const then = new Date(dateStr).getTime();
  const minutes = Math.floor((now - then) / 60000);
  if (minutes < 1) return '刚刚';
  if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}分钟前`;
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  if (hours < 24) return `${hours}小时前`;
  const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
  if (days < 30) return `${days}天前`;
  return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN');
}
```

```astro
---
import BaseLayout from '../layouts/BaseLayout.astro';
import CategoryNav from '../components/CategoryNav.astro';
import SearchBox from '../components/SearchBox.astro';
import NewsCard from '../components/NewsCard.astro';
import Footer from '../components/Footer.astro';
import type { NewsItem, Category } from '../lib/types';
import { CATEGORY_LABELS } from '../lib/types';

const { cat } = Astro.url.searchParams;
const validCategories = new Set(['research', 'industry', 'opensource', 'trending', 'policy']);
const currentCategory = cat && validCategories.has(cat) ? cat : '';

const allNews: NewsItem[] = await Astro.glob('../data/news.json').then((modules) =>
  modules[0]?.default || []
);

const filtered = currentCategory
  ? allNews.filter((item) => item.category === currentCategory)
  : allNews;

const title = currentCategory
  ? `${CATEGORY_LABELS[currentCategory as Category]} - AI News Hub`
  : 'AI News Hub - 每日 AI 新闻聚合';
---

<BaseLayout {title} {currentCategory}>
  <main>
    <CategoryNav current={currentCategory} />
    <SearchBox />
    <div class="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 space-y-3 pb-8">
      {filtered.length > 0 ? (
        filtered.map((item) => <NewsCard item={item} />)
      ) : (
        <p class="text-center text-gray-400 py-12">暂无新闻，等待下次更新...</p>
      )}
    </div>
  </main>
  <Fragment slot="footer">
    <Footer />
  </Fragment>
</BaseLayout>
```

```typescript
import type { APIRoute } from 'astro';
import type { NewsItem } from '../lib/types';

export const GET: APIRoute = async () => {
  const allNews: NewsItem[] = await Astro.glob('../data/news.json').then(
    (modules) => modules[0]?.default || []
  );

  const items = allNews.slice(0, 50).map(
    (item) => `
    <item>
      <title><![CDATA[${item.title}]]></title>
      <link>${item.url}</link>
      <description><![CDATA[${item.summary}]]></description>
      <pubDate>${new Date(item.publishedAt).toUTCString()}</pubDate>
      <source>${item.source}</source>
      <category>${item.category}</category>
    </item>`
  );

  const xml = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rss version="2.0" xmlns:atom="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom">
  <channel>
    <title>AI News Hub</title>
    <link>https://ai-news-hub.pages.dev</link>
    <description>每日 AI 新闻聚合 - 研究突破、行业动态、开源工具、热门项目、政策监管</description>
    <language>zh-CN</language>
    <atom:link href="https://ai-news-hub.pages.dev/rss.xml" rel="self" type="application/rss+xml"/>
    <lastBuildDate>${new Date().toUTCString()}</lastBuildDate>
    ${items.join('\n')}
  </channel>
</rss>`;

  return new Response(xml, {
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/xml; charset=utf-8' },
  });
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Add Pagefind support to the build**

Modify the build command to include Pagefind. Update `package.json` scripts section:

```json
"build": "astro build && npx pagefind --site dist"
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Verify build**

Run: `cd /Users/tian_d/ai-news-hub && node scripts/fetch-news.mjs && node scripts/fetch-trending.mjs && npm run build`

Expected: Build succeeds, `dist/` directory contains index.html, search/index.html, rss.xml, and pagefind indices.

---

### Task 6: GitHub Actions Workflow

**Files:**
- Create: `.github/workflows/fetch-and-deploy.yml`

- [ ] **Step 1: Create the workflow file**

Create `/Users/tian_d/ai-news-hub/.github/workflows/fetch-and-deploy.yml`:

```yaml
name: Fetch News and Deploy

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'   # 00:00 UTC = 08:00 CST
    - cron: '0 10 * * *'  # 10:00 UTC = 18:00 CST
  workflow_dispatch:       # Manual trigger

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Fetch RSS news
        run: node scripts/fetch-news.mjs

      - name: Fetch GitHub trending
        run: node scripts/fetch-trending.mjs

      - name: Build site
        run: npx astro build

      - name: Build search index
        run: npx pagefind --site dist

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          command: pages deploy dist --project-name=ai-news-hub
```
